# Kyoto Spring Getaway Overview

A relaxed 4-day Kyoto plan for **2 adults** from **2026-03-12 to 2026-03-15**, built around temples, food markets, gardens, and one easy day trip.
Budget target: **JPY 180,000 total** excluding international flights, with a comfortable buffer for food, transport, admissions, and a mid-range stay.

# 4-Day Kyoto Itinerary and Budget Plan

## Day 1 — Higashiyama Temples and Gion Stroll
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and take a slow walk through **Kiyomizu-dera** and the surrounding lanes.
- Afternoon: Explore **Sannenzaka/Ninenzaka** and pause at a tea house or sweet shop.
- Evening: Easy **Gion** walk for lantern-lit streets and dinner near the hotel.
- Local transport: **JPY 2,000**
- Meals: **JPY 12,000**
- Notes: Keep this day light to recover from arrival and settle into Kyoto’s pace.

## Day 2 — Nishiki Market and Central Kyoto Gardens
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- Morning: Browse **Nishiki Market** for snacks, pickles, tofu, seafood, and small tastings.
- Afternoon: Visit **Nijō Castle** or a nearby garden such as **Shosei-en** for a calm contrast.
- Evening: Casual kaiseki, izakaya, or a ramen stop around central Kyoto.
- Local transport: **JPY 2,500**
- Meals: **JPY 14,000**
- Notes: This is your best food-focused day, with plenty of room to wander.

## Day 3 — Easy Day Trip to Arashiyama
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Ride to **Arashiyama** and visit the **bamboo grove** early before crowds build.
- Afternoon: Choose one relaxed add-on: **Tenryu-ji Garden** or a river walk.
- Evening: Return to central Kyoto for a simple dinner and early night.
- Local transport: **JPY 3,500**
- Meals: **JPY 12,000**
- Notes: This is the single day trip, kept easy and close to Kyoto.

## Day 4 — Northern Kyoto Gardens and Departure Buffer
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Visit **Kinkaku-ji** or **Ryoan-ji** for one final temple/garden highlight.
- Afternoon: Slow lunch, souvenir shopping, and transfer to your next stop or airport rail link.
- Evening: Departure or final Kyoto dinner if your schedule allows.
- Local transport: **JPY 2,500**
- Meals: **JPY 10,000**
- Notes: Leave this day flexible so departure logistics stay stress-free.

## Budget Breakdown for 2 Adults

| Category | Estimated Cost |
|---|---:|
| Accommodation, 4 nights | JPY 72,000 |
| Local transport | JPY 10,000 |
| Meals and snacks | JPY 48,000 |
| Admissions and small extras | JPY 18,000 |
| Buffer / flexibility | JPY 32,000 |
| Total | **JPY 180,000** |

### Spending Notes
- This plan assumes a **mid-range hotel or ryokan-style stay** around central Kyoto.
- Meals are set at a comfortable level with one nicer dinner and several casual lunches.
- If you want to spend less, the easiest cuts are the hotel and one upgraded dinner.

## Rainy-Day Backup Plan

### Day 1 Backup — Kyoto Station and Museum Time
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Swap outdoor temple walking for **Kyoto Railway Museum** or **Kyoto National Museum**.
- Add a long café break and a relaxed dinner in Gion or Kyoto Station.

### Day 2 Backup — Covered Market and Indoor Culture
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- Spend more time in **Nishiki Market** and nearby arcades.
- Replace castle/garden time with a tea experience, craft shopping, or a museum.

### Day 3 Backup — Arashiyama Lite
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cloud-rain.svg
- Keep the train ride to Arashiyama, but focus on **Tenryu-ji** and indoor cafés.
- Skip the bamboo grove if rain is heavy and use the day for riverside dining and browsing.

### Day 4 Backup — Temple Plus Shopping
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg
- Choose one indoor-friendly temple or garden site, then finish with department-store food halls and souvenir shopping.
- Keep departure timing loose so weather does not create pressure.
